rationale_md: Belgium enters this Group G encounter as overwhelming favorites, backed by a substantial 320-point Elo rating advantage over Iran that reflects the gulf in quality between European contenders and Asian challengers. The Red Devils' three-in-four win probability suggests they should comfortably secure three points against an Iranian side that has historically struggled against elite European opposition in World Cup settings. Iran's best hope lies in defensive organization and set-piece opportunities, though their slim 7% chance of victory indicates such a path to an upset remains highly improbable.
